questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Mexico?

hints.nudge: It is 2 words long and starts with the letter M.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Mexico article.

questions.proof: Mexico City is the capital and largest city, which ranks among the most populous metropolitan areas in the world.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Mexico?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter B and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Mexico article.

questions.proof: It borders the United States to the north, and Guatemala and Belize to the southeast; while having maritime boundaries with the Pacific Ocean to the west, the Caribbean Sea to the southeast, and the Gulf of Mexico to the east.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Mexico?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter S and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “People” part of the Mexico article.

questions.proof: Mexico is the most populous Spanish-speaking country in the world.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Juarez stayed president until _____ invaded Mexico and made Maximilian of Habsburg emperor of the Second Mexican Empire.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter F and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Mexico article.

questions.proof: Juarez stayed president until France invaded Mexico and made Maximilian of Habsburg emperor of the Second Mexican Empire.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It is also the second most populous country in Latin America (after _____).”
